authority: Explicit prospective user instruction 2026-10-07; separate layer, not supersession of support archive

event_time_law.feature_and_baseline: Every required feature and baseline bar has s+300<=t; h=floor(t/3600)*3600; keep existing completed-hour anchors
event_time_law.peers: Frozen context and freshness/validity sets from entry masks only; no response values choose peers
event_time_law.response: Future bar k is [t+300*(k-1),t+300*k), k>=1; the response excludes the decision bar [t-300,t). The shared boundary at t is an event-time reference, not an executable fill.
event_time_law.runtime: Actual receipt must precede actual decision; missing or stale input cancels decision; execution strictly after actual decision. No zero latency claim.

layer_interpretation: Existing geometric masks can describe completed-bar ordered event geometry. This authority certifies the prospective ordering law, not historical receipt/revision provenance or any statistical power.

official_authorities.law: Live ProtoOASpotEvent trendbar supplies the last closed bar
ProtoOATrendbar utcTimestampInMinutes is the Unix time in minutes of the bar open tick
